data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 家庭餐厅薯条作战会议
data.description: 放学后的家庭餐厅，她面前摊着薯条拼盘和饮料吧的杯子，一边往嘴里送薯条一边听朋友说话，听到关键处瞪大眼睛停住动作；薯条凉了才惊觉，露出夸张的懊恼表情。

data.promptProse: In the restaurant booth, Yanami's blue hair and sailor collar are visible as she freezes with a fry halfway to her mouth. A classmate opposite her, with short brown hair and square glasses over a charcoal school sweater, leans forward to deliver the surprising news. Warm booth lamps catch the shared platter and both drinks between them.
data.animaCaption: Blue-haired Yanami stops with a fry midway to her mouth. Her short brown-haired friend in square glasses and a charcoal school sweater sits opposite in the booth.
